title: Sprinkling Dependency Injection Annotations on Business Logic
pattern: Sprinkling framework-specific annotations (such as `@Autowired`, `#[inject]`, or `@Transactional`) throughout core domain and business logic objects instead of keeping them in low-level configuration modules.
why_bad: It leaks technical infrastructure dependencies into pure business policy, meaning the business logic is no longer framework-independent or easily portable.
detection: Dependency injection annotations or macros from a third-party framework (like Spring or Rocket) placed inside core domain structs/classes.
counterexample: Using standard constructor-based dependency injection where references are passed via simple, language-native parameters without annotations.
fix: Remove annotations from domain classes, and perform wiring in a dedicated, low-level entry point (like the Main component).
